item.title: Off the Menu 2.2.0
item.description: 2.2.0 — EVERY HERO HAS A STORY. Until now only Jax had a past; now the whole herd does. Pip, Zola, Ziggy, Boulder and Legs each get their own two-minute origin story — painted stills, deadpan captions, and a voiceover that reads the story aloud (system text-to-speech; turn it off any time in Settings, Story Narration). The first time you start a run as a hero, their story plays first — a freshly recruited hero's first run tells their story too. SKIP is now a real button that stays on screen for the WHOLE story, first beat to last, and Esc skips too. The new STORIES menu replays any watched story; unwatched stories unlock by playing as that hero. And levelling up a hero in THE HERD now plays a short level-up vignette — portrait full-screen, new level, multiplier, and a joke at the savanna's expense. One per herd visit; the upgrade lands either way.
